links.outcome: Detection performance of inherently interpretable sparse BagNet versus comparable black-box model
links.effect: Sparse BagNet performed on par with a comparable black-box model and generalised well to external data.
links.quote: It performed on par with a comparable black-box model and generalised well to external data.

links.outcome: Alignment of model visual explanations with clinical expertise in ophthalmologist user study
links.effect: User study with ophthalmologists showed the visual explanations from sparse BagNet were well-aligned with clinical expertise; no numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: Through a user study with ophthalmologists, we showed that the visual explanations readily provided by the sparse BagNet model for its decisions are well-aligned with clinical expertise.

screen.reason: Evaluates an inherently interpretable deep learning model (sparse BagNet) for ERM detection on OCT images, including a reader/user study with ophthalmologists assessing explanation alignment.
